![Glass](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3102758/90884068-9549a600-e3e1-11ea-944f-481bd894560e.png)

#### An immersive and minimalistic chat UI for World of Warcraft

_Now with support for Retail (Midnight), WoW Forever, Classic Era/Hardcore,
Burning Crusade Anniversary, and Mists of Pandaria Classic._

## Demo

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7f218129-6529-436d-aee4-ccfb3227a0ec

## Why?

I wanted to have a chat UI that didn't look like it was designed in 2004.

I tried several addons that customize the chat interface but was left
unsatisfied. So I decided to make one myself.

The goal of Glass is to be unobtrusive. Messages only appear when they come in
and fades out after a few seconds. Chat tabs are hidden until the player hovers
over the chat UI. There is no always-visible background. Glass is invisible
until the player needs it.

## Install

Glass is available on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/glass)

You may also download the latest release on [GitHub](https://github.com/mixxorz/Glass/releases)

## Commands

- `/glass` - open the Home page
- `/glass lock` - unlock all Glass windows for moving and resizing
- `/glass demo` - turn demo mode on or off

By default scrolling scrolls _per message_. If you have a really long message
and you want to scroll within it, use Shift+Scroll.

## Features

- **Smooth animations** — messages slide in and fade away.
- **Flexible windows** — add, move, and resize chat panes.
- **Custom styling** — choose your fonts, spacing, colors, and backgrounds.
- **Short channel labels** — use built-in abbreviations or create your own.
- **Built-in timestamps** — 12- or 24-hour time, with optional seconds.
- **Player names** — optional race icons, class icons, and class-colored names.
- **Addon compatibility** — works with Prat, ElvUI, and Leatrix Plus.

## Chat options

Open `/glass` → **Chat options** for timestamps and player-name formatting.

Under **Player names**, enable **Race icon**,
**Class icon**, or **Class-colored names**. All three are off by default and apply
to every Glass window in the current profile. Icons fade with the messages.

Formatting requires accessible character information and native sender metadata.
Unknown characters, restricted chat, and legacy history may retain their original
appearance. Turning an option off preserves incoming formatting, including native
class colors.

## Addon compatibility

### ElvUI

Glass works with ElvUI, but make sure to disable the Chat module.

### Prat 3.0

Glass works with Prat, but make sure to disable the EditBox module.

There is no Prat timestamp-provider integration. Prat history can still flow
through native chat buffers; Glass uses saved original epoch times and identity
metadata where available. Missing metadata and uncertain provenance limit
historical timestamp and channel formatting, and custom or legacy histories
may retain their original styles.

Arbitrary timestamps already baked into Prat's saved text may remain and can
coexist with a Glass timestamp. Disable Prat timestamp generation for future
messages when using Glass-owned timestamps. This does not erase prefixes
already saved in history.

### Leatrix Plus

Glass works with Leatrix Plus. You might encounter issues when enabling features
that modify chat behaviour such as "Recent chat window" or "Use easy resizing".
Switching these features off will resolve issues with Glass.

## Issues and suggestions

Check the [Issue tracker](https://github.com/mixxorz/Glass/issues) on GitHub
to see if someone else has already reported your issue. If not, leave a comment
on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/glass).

releases.notes:
# 2.2.0 (2026-11-16)

## New features

- Add optional race icons, class icons, and class-colored player names.

## Changes

- Move Glass settings to Settings → AddOns → Glass.
- Move timestamps and player-name settings to Chat options.
- Match Message formatting categories and entries to WoW's native chat settings.
- Expand the unlocked Social mover to cover the icon and Battle.net notification area.

## Bug fixes

- Make Battle.net notifications follow the Social icon's position.

# 2.1.0 (2026-11-11)

New features

- Customize channel labels, text colors, and message backgrounds under Message formatting.
- Add native timestamp functionality, with 12 or 24 hour formats, seconds, and a color customization.
- Customizable chat channel aliases like `[1]` for General, `[G]` for Guild, and so on.
- Preview message formatting with `/glass demo`.

Changes

- Chat labels are shortened by default, such as `[Guild]` to `[G]`; customize or disable this in Message formatting.
- Native timestamps replace WoW's built-in timestamps.

Bug fixes

- Fix extra messages appearing in restored chat history.

# 2.0.0 (2026-11-05)

Glass 2.0 brings the changes from the 1.9 and 2.0 alphas to the stable release.

New features

- Add extra chat windows with independent source tabs, styles, layout, scrollback, and mouse-interaction settings.
- Add drag-to-resize controls while windows are unlocked with `/glass lock`.
- Add demo mode on Home and `/glass demo` to preview styles and animations without changing real chat history.
- Add configurable message and tab gradients, fonts, padding, spacing, and top/bottom message fades.
- Add separate transition controls for messages, tab bars, and the edit box, plus Never fade out options for messages and tab bars.
- Add configurable Alt-arrow editing and grouped chat-input settings under Edit box.
- Restore Blizzard's chat menu, Chat Channels button, and movable Social/Friends widget with independent visibility settings.

Improvements

- Update client compatibility for Retail (Midnight), WoW Forever, Classic Era/Hardcore, Burning Crusade Anniversary, and Mists of Pandaria Classic.
- Reorganize settings around Home and individual windows.
- Add a circular jump-to-latest button with an unread glow and a Glass icon in WoW's AddOn List and Home settings.
- Mouse wheel scrolls per message; use Shift+Scroll to move within long messages.
- Reduce layout work during profile changes, large history restorations, and incoming message bursts.

Bug fixes

- Fix errors caused by secret chat text during boss encounters and other restricted content. Secret messages retain Glass's styling and fades; incoming batches containing secret text skip sliding.
- Support multilingual text with native font families; custom fonts apply to Latin text.
- Fix Classic chat-tab initialization, optional chat-button startup errors, and duplicate temporary-window allocation.
- Preserve native chat-input handlers and fix Prat Editbox hook errors. Prat's Editbox module must still be disabled to avoid layout and visibility conflicts.
- Fix empty custom chat tabs, Combat Log toolbar overlap, message rewrapping, slider dragging, and messages appearing below the window when jumping to the latest message.
- Fix missing or invalid fonts leaving chat text without a usable font.
